en.headline: HKEX targets T+1 settlement for cash market in second half of 2028
en.dek: The exchange operator received broad support in consultation and will adopt a three-layer implementation framework, with Southbound Stock Connect following the same cycle.
body: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing said it targets implementing a T+1 settlement cycle for the cash market in the second half of 2028, subject to market readiness and regulatory approval.

The decision follows a consultation that drew 109 non-duplicated responses from brokers, custodians, investment managers and other participants, showing broad support for shortening the current T+2 cycle. The earlier target of the fourth quarter of 2027 has been deferred to allow more preparation time.

HKEX will adopt a three-layer framework covering upgrades to its post-trade infrastructure, new workflow tools and industry-wide coordination. Southbound Stock Connect transactions will follow Hong Kong's settlement arrangements. Chief Executive Officer Bonnie Y Chan said the move would reduce settlement risk, improve capital efficiency and strengthen market resilience.

zh.headline: 港交所目標2028年下半年實施港股現貨T+1結算周期
zh.dek: 諮詢獲市場廣泛支持，將採三層實施方案，港股通同步過渡。
body: 香港交易所表示，視乎市場準備情況及監管機構批准，目標於2028年下半年為股票現貨市場實施T+1結算周期。
是次決定基於諮詢總結，共收到109份非重複回應，來自經紀、託管商、投資經理及其他持份者，顯示市場廣泛支持將現行T+2周期縮短。原訂2027年第四季的目標已延後，以給予市場更多準備時間。
港交所將採用三層實施方案，包括提升交易後基礎設施、開發工作流程工具及協調全行業準備。港股通將繼續沿用香港結算安排並同步過渡。行政總裁陳翊庭表示，過渡至T+1有助降低交收風險、提高資本效率及增強市場韌性。
